decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PA 02, PA 03, PA 04, PA 05, PA 06, PA 07 Revision B, PA 1, Unnumbered Design & Access Statement, Unnumbered Environmental Statement, Unnumbered Statement Information For Installation Of External Flue, Unnumbered Additional Filtration Information, received 20/09/2013, Gigabox fan information, received 29/10/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - No additional fans, louvers, ducts or other external plant shall be installed without the prior approval of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The proposed kitchen extract system shall only be operated between the hours of 11:00 to 23:00 (as described in the Environmental Assessment report, dated 19 September 2013 and received 23 October 2013).

Condition : 5 - The rating level of any noise generated by plant & equipment as part of the development shall be at least 10 dB below the pre-existing background level as determined by BS4142: 1997-"Method of rating industrial noise affecting mixed residential and industrial areas".

Condition : 6 - Kitchen Extraction System

The kitchen extract system should comprise of the nine elements (B - J) shown on drawing number PA 03 and should include a carbon filtration block and Gigabox: GBW 335/4 kitchen extractor unit (as described in the Environmental Assessment report, dated 19 September 2013 and received 23 October 2013) where:
a.  The ceiling construction shall be: two layers of acoustic plaster board (sound board 12.5+15mm) on the joist and another 15 mm layer on a suspended ceiling leaving no less than 150 mm air space between the ceiling and the suspended ceiling and 
b. Rock wool (density 35KG/cubic m) should be used to fill 50% of the airspace between the ceilings and also between the floor joists
c. The kitchen filtration system shall be serviced in accordance with the specification from the supplier and on a regular basis.
